description: Wire LoginForm/RegisterForm to the real Supabase sign-in/sign-up through useAuthSubmit (retire the placeholder token), add a sign-out affordance, and feed the real userId from useSession into useMacroGoal/useSaveMacroGoal in App.tsx. Reconcile the storage decision (supabase-js owns session persistence; retire the session-<Date.now()> placeholder). Update the existing form tests that asserted the placeholder, and add an integration test proving a successful login exposes a userId that enables useMacroGoal.
steps: Create a small submit-handler hook/factory, e.g. apps/macros-web/src/features/auth/useAuthActions.ts, exporting makeLoginSubmit() and makeRegisterSubmit() (or a single hook) that return AuthSubmitHandler functions calling signInWithPassword/signUpWithPassword from auth.data with getSupabaseClient() (client injectable for tests). The register handler maps RegisterValues -> { email, password } (drop confirmPassword). Keep immutable, < 50 lines.

Refactor apps/macros-web/src/features/auth/useAuthSubmit.ts: remove the useAuthStorage import and the placeholder `storage.saveToken(`session-${Date.now()}`)`. Rewrite defaultSubmit to perform ONLY the redacted logging (logger(label, redactCredentials(values))) and leave the real backend call to the injected onSubmit. Keep the redacted-logging behavior, the submitted/submitError state machine, and the friendly non-leaky errorMessage seam intact. Do NOT log the password.

Update LoginForm.tsx and RegisterForm.tsx so the real onSubmit (from useAuthActions) is used by default when no onSubmit prop is passed (keep the prop injectable for tests). Preserve the existing success-screen and submitError UI and the Enchanted/Cozy primitives (FormCard, PrimaryButton, AuthField). Map common AuthError cases to the existing friendly Spanish errorMessage (invalid credentials for login, email already registered for register) without leaking provider text.

Add a sign-out affordance: in App.tsx (or AuthScreen) show a SecondaryButton 'Cerrar sesion' when useSession().status === 'authenticated' that calls signOut(getSupabaseClient()); reuse existing Button primitive and Spanish copy (add a key to copy.es.ts if needed, no new colors).

In App.tsx, read userId from useSession() and pass it to useMacroGoal(userId) / useSaveMacroGoal(userId) so they light up with a real user. If App.tsx does not yet call these hooks, add a minimal integration point (e.g. render a small macro-goal status/section gated on userId) consistent with existing layout; keep it focused.

Update apps/macros-web/src/features/auth/__tests__/LoginForm.test.tsx and RegisterForm.test.tsx: REMOVE/REPLACE only the assertions tied to the retired placeholder (the 'persists a non-secret placeholder token via storage' test and the storage mock). Keep and adapt the validation, injected-onSubmit, and redacted-logging tests. Do not delete meaningful coverage; replace placeholder assertions with assertions that the injected real onSubmit path is invoked.

Add an integration test apps/macros-web/src/features/auth/__tests__/authFlow.integration.test.tsx: render LoginForm with an injected onSubmit backed by a mocked auth.data signInWithPassword that resolves a session with user.id, inside a SessionProvider using a mock client whose onAuthStateChange emits that session; then assert that a useMacroGoal(userId) consumer becomes enabled (fetchStatus !== 'idle') once userId is present. Mock supabase client/data; no live Supabase. Keep self-contained (no @energy).

Confirm no leftover reference to the placeholder token remains (grep for 'session-' template in useAuthSubmit) and that TokenStorage is no longer used to store the Supabase JWT. Document in code comments that supabase-js owns session persistence.
acceptance_criteria: LoginForm/RegisterForm submit through useAuthSubmit call the real signInWithPassword/signUpWithPassword (mocked in tests); no placeholder `session-<Date.now()>` token is written anywhere.
useAuthSubmit no longer imports or uses useAuthStorage; the password is never logged (redactCredentials preserved).
App.tsx passes a real userId from useSession() into useMacroGoal/useSaveMacroGoal; a sign-out affordance appears when authenticated.
Updated LoginForm/RegisterForm tests pass without asserting the retired placeholder; a new integration test shows a successful login yields a userId that enables useMacroGoal.
Full suite `npm run test:coverage` passes with >=80% coverage; `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, and `npm run build` pass (energy domain materialized temporarily, then removed before finishing).
findings: REVIEW FOLLOW-UP (2026-10-05-040440-review.md) addressed all 4 issues. (1) Save mutation wired: App.tsx now builds SaveMacroGoalInput via new toSaveMacroGoalInput.ts (maps MacroResult+userId -> {user_id, goal_type:'mantenimiento', tdee(rounded), calorie_target, protein_g/fat_g/carbs_g}; no mutation of result) and calls saveMacroGoal.mutate inside a useCallback handleSaveGoal gated on userId (write authz left to RLS). MacrosWizard gained an optional onSave?(result) prop invoked from the Step4 save action (handleSave) while keeping the local 'guardaron con éxito' confirmation for signed-out users. (2) Bootstrap race fixed: SessionProvider seed now applies via a functional setState that only overwrites when prev.status==='loading', so a late getCurrentSession seed can never clobber a newer onAuthStateChange event; auth events remain authoritative. Added a useSession test that fires SIGNED_IN before a deferred seed resolves and asserts the authenticated state survives. (3) Sign-up null-session: AuthSubmitHandler<T,R> is now generic over a result; useAuthSubmit forwards the resolved result to an optional onResult before flipping submitted; makeRegisterSubmit returns {pendingConfirmation: session===null} (new RegisterResult). RegisterForm shows COPY.register.confirmEmail ('revisa tu correo' Enchanted/Cozy Spanish copy, no new colors) when pending, else the plain success. Added RegisterForm tests for null-session (confirmEmail) and session (plain success). (4) act() warnings removed: App.test.tsx renderApp is async and awaits the settled seed (waitFor step-1). Added tests: toSaveMacroGoalInput.test.ts (mapper), saveGoalWiring.integration.test.tsx (authenticated App completes wizard -> saveMacroGoal called with mapped input), MacrosWizard onSave assertion, bootstrap-race + register confirm/success tests. Verification from apps/macros-web: typecheck PASS, lint PASS (0 warnings), test:coverage PASS (28 files, 156 tests; All files 98.81% lines / 92.85% branches, >=80%), build PASS (pre-existing >500kB chunk-size warning only). No act() warnings remain (only the intentional outside-provider throw logs an expected error). Energy domain under /projects/sandbox/APP/src/features/energy remains untracked and was NOT staged. ORIGINAL PASS: Implemented useAuthActions.ts (makeLoginSubmit/makeRegisterSubmit; register drops confirmPassword; client injectable, defaults to getSupabaseClient()). Refactored useAuthSubmit.ts to remove useAuthStorage and the session-<Date.now()> placeholder; defaultSubmit now only does redacted logging and the real call is the injected onSubmit. LoginForm/RegisterForm default to the real handler via useMemo(onSubmit ?? makeLoginSubmit()) and keep onSubmit injectable; friendly Spanish errors updated (no provider text leak). App.tsx reads userId from useSession and calls useSaveMacroGoal(userId); new SessionPanel.tsx shows 'Cerrar sesion' (SecondaryButton) + a macro-goal status (useMacroGoal(userId)) when status==='authenticated'. Added copy.es session keys (signOut/goalLoading/goalActive/goalEmpty). Updated supabaseClient.ts doc comment to note supabase-js owns session persistence. NOTE: FEAT-001's auth.data.ts + auth.data.test.ts were still untracked (uncommitted) at session start, so they were committed together with FEAT-003. Tests: rewrote LoginForm/RegisterForm tests to drop the retired placeholder/storage mock and mock auth.data for the default path (+ friendly-error and confirmPassword-dropped assertions); added useAuthSubmit.test.ts (preserves redacted-logging coverage of the default path), useAuthActions.test.ts, SessionPanel.test.tsx, and authFlow.integration.test.tsx (login via injected onSubmit emits a session through a mock client's onAuthStateChange; useMacroGoal(userId) transitions fetchStatus to 'fetching' once userId present). App.test.tsx now wraps App in SessionProvider (mock client) + QueryProvider. Integration/App/SessionPanel tests mock lib/supabaseClient.getSupabaseClient so no live env is needed. Verification from apps/macros-web: typecheck PASS, lint PASS (0 warnings), test:coverage PASS (26 files, 148 tests; All files 98.94% lines / 93.21% branches, >=80%), build PASS (pre-existing >500kB chunk-size warning only). Energy domain under /projects/sandbox/APP/src/features/energy was left untouched and NOT staged.
